summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time capture feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (TimeElapsedColumn placed before TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now means finished_time is present; capture in update and advance inside the lock; clear in _reset and reset), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with a 3-column table, imports inside the method, TYPE_CHECKING import for Table), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with Added entries for TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__), tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast), tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, and its expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads). No tests were run, per instruction. Caveats: the test_columns expected output is an unverified hand trace (bar widths 33->25 and 23->16 were checked against the base output's layout); the speed padding change follows from the changed speed text; docs/source/progress.rst was not updated as out of scope.
